name: Liquid Glass
description:
Applies a translucent, refractive 'liquid glass' effect (blur, tint, specular highlights and edge lighting) to the top bar and its menus, Quick Settings, notifications, OSDs, Dash to Dock or Dhruva and selected application windows, with adaptive text contrast and extensive customization. Optionally adds a clock with glass digits, weather, calendar and media widgets on the desktop, and a search launcher on glass.

The weather widget asks Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com) for the forecast only when GNOME Weather is not installed and a place has been chosen in the preferences; the place search in the preferences also uses Open-Meteo.

Clipboard: the launcher writes a calculation's result to the clipboard when you choose that result (Enter or a click). It never reads the clipboard.
